title: Notification badge repair — TestFlight 1.3 (33)
lede: Push taps now read their notification, and the icon reconciles with the server unread count. Physical-device visual acceptance remains open.

changes.was: Opening a push navigated to its destination without marking the inbox row read.
changes.now: The destination opens immediately; the app marks that row read and fetches the current unread count.

changes.was: An unchanged cached count skipped the system badge write, even when APNs had changed the icon.
changes.now: Every successful unread refresh reapplies the count, including zero. Writes are serialized.

changes.was: Dashboard or trade errors and a shell refresh throttle could prevent badge reconciliation.
changes.now: Unread reconciliation runs independently; foreground push presentation uses a fresh server count.

verification: Two source regression checks failed on the pre-fix code and pass after the fix.

notes: Visual comparison unavailable: no authenticated physical APNs scenario or matched icon captures were collected. This page documents behavior and automated evidence; it is not screenshot proof.
On iPhone: tap a push, mark all read, return after reading elsewhere, receive a foreground push, and sign out. Compare the inbox unread count and app icon each time.
Existing unread inbox rows remain unread until read individually or marked all read. Merely opening the app does not erase unread history.
